dedupe_keys.name: northern gas networks open data portal distribution mains interruptions emergencies linepack and demand northern england

description: The Northern Gas Networks Open Data Portal publishes data from the gas distribution network operator Northern Gas Networks, and states that the data on it are classified as Open and available to use without restriction. The home page read on the day of cataloguing linked 26 data sets, among them live low and medium pressure distribution mains as GIS line features for the Central, Tees, The North, The Ridings and West Yorkshire areas, decommissioned mains left in situ, network boundaries, and the proposed East Coast Hydrogen network. Event data include anonymised unplanned interruptions to gas supply, public reported emergencies with response times, carbon monoxide incidents and emergency appliance checks; operational data include daily linepack and total demand and daily biomethane volumes by entry point; there are also smart meter installation statistics by postcode outcode, Priority Services Register counts by patch, customer complaints and scores, greenhouse gas emissions, a data catalogue of data sets considered for sharing, and project data such as the Knapton hydrogen to power storage study. Coverage is the NGN distribution area in northern England. Access is free through the portal as GIS layers, Excel and PDF files. Caveats: mains layers are described as intended for use in a geographical information system, and some items are summaries, not records. Simulation uses are gas distribution network models, interruption and emergency response analysis, and hydrogen conversion planning. Related records: data-national-gas-transmission-data-portal covers the transmission system upstream.
